europe_now.title: Security Incident at UK Air Base
europe_now.summary: UK police and counter-terrorism forces arrested multiple individuals following a major security incident involving suspected explosive offenses near an air base utilized by US forces. Several nearby homes were evacuated as bomb disposal teams examined the vehicles.

sources.headline: UK police make arrests, evacuate homes in ‘major incident’ near air base used by US forces
Major incident declared at UK air base used by US forces

europe_now.title: Swiss Neutrality Vote
europe_now.summary: Swiss voters have rejected proposals to harden the country's neutrality principle, a decision that safeguards existing sanctions against Russia.

sources.headline: Swiss say no to hardening neutrality principle, safeguarding sanctions on Russia

top_stories.title: Papal Visit to France
top_stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV continued his apostolic visit to France with events in Paris and the Lourdes pilgrimage site. During his engagements, he urged the Catholic Church to face its failings and met with abuse survivors.

sources.headline: Pope Leo continues his visit to France in Lourdes

top_stories.title: Housing Protests in Spain
top_stories.summary: Thousands of demonstrators marched through Madrid to protest rising housing costs and evictions. The mobilization highlights a broader social crisis confronting the country.
